recipes.name: Kimchi stew with tuna (Chamchi-kimchi-jjigae: 참치김치찌개)
ingredients: 1 pound fermented kimchi, cut into 2 inch long pieces
2 green onion, one cut diagonally into pieces and one chopped up into small pieces
2 teaspoons Turbinado sugar (or white or brown sugar)
8 ounces tofu (about 1 cup), sliced into bite size pieces
instructions: Place the kimchi in a shallow, heavy pot or pan. Add kimchi brine, onion, green onion, kosher salt, hot pepper flakes, sugar, and toasted sesame oil. Add 2½ cups water and cover. Cook for 25 minutes over medium high heat. If it boils over, crack the lid a little and if the water boils out, add more so that the kimchi and all the ingredients are always submerged.
Stir the stew with a wooden spoon and add tuna and tofu. Continue to cook for another 5 minutes until the tofu turns soft.
Sprinkle with the chopped green onion and serve right away with rice and more side dishes if you desire.
